limitations: Dynamic pixel checks verify only the frozen final generation, not each render frame.
v6 cases ran sequentially in one warmed instance; no randomized or repeated laboratory comparison.
FPS scalar sample counts are small and CPU call timings do not measure GPU completion.
v6 interval4 CPU stage summary excluded because skipped uploads duplicated old stage timings.
v8 12KiB updates finished before warmup and have no FPS, interval or steady-stage samples.
1MiB pixel failure and incomplete 256KiB background-guard scan remain source failures.
The prior v5 legacy8 256KiB static pass does not establish compact8 capacity.
Fresh geometry names have bounded session accounting; native reclamation and indefinite streaming are unverified.
